additional_info.subject: Case notes
additional_info.body:
Hello,
regarding the charger n. 314015297001 (we can't find it in the asset), a client called us because he can't stop a charging session.
He stopped it on POS monitor and passed the credit card. The charger invited him to remove the cable but the cable was locked and the charge still goes on.
He tried also with the App of the car, unsuccessfully. We also tried by remote, but also in this case the cable was locked and the session on.
So we launch reboot of the charger so the cable was unlocked the session ended. Please, check what happened
Hereby, charging details:
UTC TIME
Start at 10.46 am on dec17th
Ended Time at 11.27 am on dec 17th
Wait for a kind response
Thank you in advance.
software version
: v8.0.5-0-g33a6c1d+APN

additional_info.subject: ID0468210-DC/Si-D/IT-[Y2/SD314015297001] Not possible to end charge session CRM:03056000812
additional_info.body:
Dear Maria,
Thank you for contacting eMobility support.
After carefully checking the logs, i see that during the charging session the OCPP connection went offline.
Because of this lost connection the cable stayed blocked, and could not react to the request to stop the charging session.
Right now i see that the OCPP connection is stable and there are no error codes appearing.
I hope this answered your question.
Please provide me with feedback, or let me know if you are still facing issues.
Kind regards,
Priscilla van Wettum
